Man Arrested for Wife's Murder in Delhi

A man was arrested in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, for allegedly stabbing his wife to death with scissors in Delhi's Seelampur area. Police used technical surveillance and informant tips to track the accused, who had been changing his location to evade arrest. The motive cited in some reports is suspicion of infidelity. The victim was found in a pool of blood at their Delhi home. The accused was arrested after three days.
